dedup.scope: The public identity index, the retired-claims record, the current worklist, the manifest entry of the public item taken from the same source and the sibling card prepared from the same source were searched with the object names of this claim; only the independent statement named in the counted unit is counted.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: the counted public unit is the sharpness Proposition at source lines 358-360 with its proof at 361-404. Here Theorem mainthmSaeed (source lines 168-176) is counted with its own complete proof at 194-230; in the public unit this theorem appears only as retained context (manifest context span 168-176) and its proof is not retained, so this is a statement that has never been counted with its proof.

compared.kind: sibling card from the same source
compared.difference: The sibling card counts Theorem mainthmSaeed2, the equitable-colorability-defect bound ecd^r(H); the present card counts Theorem mainthmSaeed, the alternation-number bound |V(H)|-alt_r(H). The article proves them in two separate sections and records at source lines 285-292 that the two quantities are not comparable, each of the signs less, equal and greater occurring for suitable H, so neither statement implies the other; the proofs differ in the augmentation identity that has to be verified (alt_r(H~) = alt_r(H) at source line 218 against ecd^r(H~) >= |V(H~)|-|V(H)|+ecd^r(H) at source lines 328-335 of the sibling card).
